model_system: fcc Ti thin film / bulk Ti orbital Hall effect
headline_claim: Ti exhibits a large orbital Hall conductivity of 3800 (ħ/e)(Ω·cm)^-1, about two orders of magnitude larger than its spin Hall conductivity of -40 (ħ/e)(Ω·cm)^-1.
replication_difficulty: high - requires multiorbital orbital-Berry-curvature/Kubo calculations plus thin-film orbital drift-diffusion and magneto-optical modeling.
